description: Advisory profile for the published Top Mail.ru page-view producer and its noscript counter. Numeric identity follows the help guide. Age and gender checks apply only to the pinned SDK js=13 profile. Receiver acceptance and other Mail.ru transports remain unverified.

params.name: id
params.description: The producer serializes the configured numeric counter identifier.

params.name: js
params.description: Only the pinned js=13 profile enables producer-specific demographic checks.

params.name: age
params.description: The pinned producer retains integer ages from 1 through 127.

params.name: gender
params.description: The pinned producer retains these two codes; this is a transport profile.
